title: Money Balance
adjustIntro: New entries post to the cash ledger bucket for that currency (card buckets are legacy-only).
errNoteRequired: Please enter a note for this balance adjustment.

conversion.title: Currency conversion
conversion.intro: Convert between USD and UZS cash buckets. Central Bank rate is used for the expected amount; you may adjust the received amount — any difference is recorded as conversion profit or loss in P&L.
conversion.noPlEffect: No P&L effect — converted amount matches CB rate.
conversion.errAmounts: Enter valid source and converted amounts.
conversion.errRate: Exchange rate is not available. Try again in a moment.

footerHint: Amounts roll up by currency; bucket column shows the underlying ledger row.

transfer.title: Move money between accounts
transfer.feeHint: What the bank or gateway kept. What arrives is the amount less the fee.
transfer.dateHint: The day the money actually moved, not the day it was typed.
transfer.sameCurrencyHint: Same-currency accounts only. Changing currency is a conversion.
transfer.closedReason: Reason for posting into a closed month
transfer.closedReasonHint: This month is closed. Give a reason — it is recorded in the register.
